question: What powers over time and form arise as results of this advanced practice?
premises: Time can be overcome or deceived
These results are addressed to the goddess
inference: The practice leads to the deception of time and the transformation of form.
uncertainties: vañcanaṃ may mean cheating, overcoming, or transcending in this context
plain_english: O goddess, there is the overcoming of time and the transformation of form.
